en: The postcard features a collage of four black-and-white photographs: the interior of a rustic tavern or beer hall, an exterior view of a large house or lodge, a timbered cottage identified as 'Theodorhütte,' and a tall observation tower labeled 'Spelunkenthurm.' There is also an oval portrait of a man in a crown and ceremonial dress, titled 'Theodor der Grosse, Präsident.' The center of the design is labeled 'Spelunke.' The border of the postcard is decorated with grapevine motifs, enhancing its rustic, festive theme. The reverse side references the Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont, a museum in a German palace.
